title: AgentsRun
description: agents.run@1 (one agent system, 2026-11-12): one run of an agent, the same shape on every product (Actor, Codes, Run and anything else on openvibe-sdk/agents). The owner is the person or agent the work belongs to; AGENT names the agent or harness that runs it and the product it comes from; PARENT_RUN makes sub-agent runs a tree; BUDGET is the hard limit and COST what the run has spent; STATUS is where the run is now. The run is stored by its product, not here: this contract is the wire shape. GET /api/v1/runs, /api/v1/runs/{id} and /api/v1/runs/{id}/steps serve it (OpenVibe.Actor) and the SDK's runs client reads it. The product's own id is kept, never reused. A run that ends keeps its end status. This v1 contract may grow optional fields; a step is agents.step@1 and an approval is agents.approval@1.

id.description: The product's own run id (Actor's tsk_…, Codes' tsk_…, a Run job's job_…). Unique within its product and never reused.

owner.description: The person or agent the run belongs to: the subject the work is done for.

agent.description: The agent or harness that runs it. ID is the product's own agent id or slug; NAME is what a person reads; PRODUCT is the product it comes from (actor, codes, run, chat, …).

parent_run.description: The run that started this one (a sub-agent), or null. The parent's run card nests children; the child's budget is a slice of the parent's.

budget.description: The hard limit the run may not exceed. A field that is absent is not limited. USD is money; TOKENS counts model tokens in and out; SECONDS is wall time; STEPS counts the appended steps.

status.description: planning: accepted, no step yet. running: a step is under way. waiting: the run waits for its person (an approval or a takeover) and costs nothing. done, failed and stopped are the end statuses; an end status never changes.

updated_at.description: When the run last changed: its newest step, its end, or its creation when nothing has happened yet.

result_summary.description: What the run answered or what is left, in plain words, for a run card. The full result stays the product's (Actor's result, Codes' result.summary). Null until there is one.

cost.description: What the run has spent so far, to the product's own precision. Null before anything is known.
